version 15.9
hostname rt-v04
!
no cdp run
lldp run
vlan internal allocation policy ascending
!
vtp mode transparent
!
spanning-tree mode pvst
spanning-tree loopguard default
errdisable recovery cause bpduguard
errdisable recovery interval 600
!
vlan 10,20
!
interface FastEthernet0
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree guard root
 no cdp enable
!
interface FastEthernet1
 switchport access vlan 10
 no cdp enable
 no lldp transmit
!
interface FastEthernet2
 switchport access vlan 20
 lldp receive
!
interface FastEthernet3
 switchport access vlan 20
!
interface GigabitEthernet8
 ip address 203.0.113.14 255.255.255.252
 no cdp enable
!
interface Vlan10
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.128
!
interface Vlan20
 ip address 192.0.2.129 255.255.255.128
!
monitor session 1 source interface Fa0
monitor session 1 source interface Fa1 tx
monitor session 1 destination interface Fa3
!
end
